description: A low-resolution image of a handwritten signature presented within a rectangular box. The signature is rendered in cursive script, prominently beginning with a capital 'R' followed by further cursive characters that visually resemble "Lacaze". A distinct diagonal line strikes through the signature. This image is embedded within a "DOCUMENT RELEASE SHEET" and is contextually positioned as the signature for "Book captain: C. Paulik" with a date of "21.07.2015".
